description: This file contains the implementation of a function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes raw cost data records into a format suitable for charting with Recharts. It groups the records by service and category (or environment), and handles zero-filling for missing categories within services, enabling the creation of stacked series visualizations.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a stacked series dataset suitable for charting, organizing data by specified categories or environments, with options for sorting and labeling.
